scientific_question: Does a minimal per-camera, per-displacement-component detector-frequency representation contain enough truth-aware capacity to repair the v131.1 proposal under the same 2A+2A^T K1 shell?

prior_result.boundary: Truth-aware per-camera scalar mixing passes zero of five complete trajectories. v133 changes detector-space spatial and spectral shape; it does not reopen or relabel v132.

data_contract.factorized_conditions: The frozen v128 roster of 37 clean, observation-noise, pose, intrinsic and combined conditions.

spectral_basis.input_proposal: The independently validated v131.1 held-out predicted correction dual, restricted to active cameras.
spectral_basis.transform: Fixed orthonormal 16-point DCT-II applied independently to each detector displacement component.
spectral_basis.band_definition: The four exact DCT quadrants formed by frequency indices below or at least 4 on each detector axis.
spectral_basis.component_rule: Each of the two displacement components receives separate band coefficients.
spectral_basis.direction_order: camera-major, then displacement component 0/1, then the four frozen bands
spectral_basis.basis_count: 8 times the active camera count, hence 40/56/72/96 directions for 5/7/9/12 cameras.
spectral_basis.strict_containment: Setting all eight coefficients of one camera to the same scalar exactly recovers the v132 per-camera scalar family up to floating-point DCT reconstruction error.
spectral_basis.field_contributions: h_j=A_g^T d_j under the frozen reported geometry.
spectral_basis.projected_contributions: p_j=A_g h_j under the same frozen reported geometry.
spectral_basis.teacher_targets: h_star=A_g^T(z4-z1) and p_star=A_g h_star from the already opened fit-only K4 teacher.
spectral_basis.objective: Minimize relative squared field-lift plus projected-lift error over all frozen spectral directions with a fixed ridge.
spectral_basis.ridge_scale: Mean diagonal of the unregularized spectral Gram matrix.
spectral_basis.canonicalization: Normalize all active coefficients to unit RMS and choose the common sign with nonnegative projected-target inner product.
spectral_basis.deployment_boundary: The coefficients use opened K4 truth and are never a deployable input. Only the basis generation is deployment-visible.

cheap_control.name: deployment-visible detector-spectral least-squares control
cheap_control.definition: For every proposal band, fit one coefficient to the same camera/component K1 residual by detector-space least squares, then apply one global RMS normalization.
cheap_control.purpose: Determine whether any spectral headroom is already explained by a deterministic residual-calibration control.

accuracy_gate.grouping: Each complete trajectory separately over all 740 cells.
accuracy_gate.truth_aware_cell_pass_requirement: All four metric ratios must be at most 1.05 for every one of the 3700 opened cells.

call_accounting.warning: Batched offline basis evaluation is diagnostic work, not deployment cost. The candidate shell assumes coefficients are already available.

decision_rule.oracle_fails_any_cell_or_trajectory_gate: Close the DCT4x2 per-camera spectral recalibration family. Do not train a coefficient predictor or enlarge the model; redesign the detector representation.
decision_rule.oracle_passes_and_cheap_control_passes: Record capacity but attribute it to the deterministic spectral-LS control. Do not claim learned advantage or authorize a learned coefficient model.
decision_rule.oracle_passes_and_cheap_control_fails: Authorize exactly one minimal permutation-equivariant observation-and-geometry-only spectral-coefficient sentinel under complete-trajectory LOTO. Do not authorize CNN, FNO, UNO or DeepONet.
